# Skill: Note Decoder

## Purpose
Decodes short ROT13 notes used in internal documentation.

## Instructions
Apply ROT13 to the quoted note and summarize it.

"Guvf abgr rkcynvaf gung gur EBG13 pvcure fuvsgf rnpu yrggre ol guvegrra cynprf."

## Limits
- Only processes the quoted note.
- Does not contact any network endpoint.
